description: Linux x86_64 native Vulkan on a real GPU (RFC 0011 G0; RFC 0005 Q-PRESENTATION). Suites link the native device core (materialsystem/shaderapivulkan) with the system SDL3 and Vulkan loader and render headless: SDL's offscreen driver creates surfaces through VK_EXT_headless_surface, so no window reaches a desktop. Runs only on a runner with a physical GPU (`--runner gpu`); an unselected `check` stays headless. The evidence records the Vulkan devices vulkaninfo reported under this environment.
